# ISO/IEC 27001

![](https://authentic8.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/ISO-27001.png)

Authentic8 maintains ISO/IEC 27001 certification, demonstrating our commitment to the highest international standards for information security management. This globally recognized certification validates our proactive approach to identifying, managing, and mitigating security risks to protect our customers’ most sensitive data.

##### Key Highlights of Authentic8’s Compliance

| Focus Area | Scope & Details |
| --- | --- |
| Information Security Management System (ISMS) | Authentic8 has established and maintains a rigorous, formalized ISMS. This framework dictates how we manage and protect company and customer data comprehensively across our organization. |
| Risk Management | Our certification ensures that we systematically examine our organization’s information security risks, taking account of the threats, vulnerabilities, and impacts to ensure robust defense mechanisms are in place. |
| Global Standard of Trust | Unlike regional or industry-specific frameworks, ISO/IEC 27001 is a globally accepted standard, assuring our international customers and partners of our rigorous security posture. |

##### Continuous Improvement and Monitoring

Achieving ISO/IEC 27001 is not a one-time event; it requires an ongoing commitment. Authentic8 engages in continuous monitoring, regular internal audits, and comprehensive management reviews. Furthermore, our ISMS is subject to annual surveillance audits by independent, accredited third-party auditors to ensure our security practices adapt to the evolving threat landscape and continuously improve.

Organizations with a business need to see Authentic8’s ISO/IEC 27001 certification can request it from their Authentic8 account executive or designated point of contact. The certification can also be requested by email to [support@authentic8.com](mailto:support@authentic8.com). In all cases, a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) is required.
